A Victorian Anthology, 1837–1895

Selections Illustrating the Editor’s Critical Review of British Poetry in the Reign of Victoria

Edited by Edmund Clarence Stedman

These 1,274 works by 343 authors represent the full course of one of the great literary ages of English verse. Organized by class, this encyclopedic collection complements Stedman’s 
American Anthology
